import cadquery as cq
# Generating a workplane for sketch 0
wp_sketch0 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.453125, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)))
loop0=wp_sketch0.moveTo(0.45394736842105265, 0.0).circle(0.45394736842105265)
loop1=wp_sketch0.moveTo(0.45394736842105265, 0.0).circle(0.3026315789473684)
solid0=wp_sketch0.add(loop0).add(loop1).extrude(0.453125)
solid=solid0
# Generating a workplane for sketch 1
wp_sketch1 = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(cq.Vector(-0.296875, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), cq.Vector(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)))

solid=solid.union(solid1)
